title: Jellyseerr
descript: Jellyseerr is a request manager for Jellyfin, Plex and Emby: users browse your libraries, request movies and TV shows, and the app tracks availability. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container and keeps its configuration and database in the application data folder.
important: First run: open the web UI and complete the setup wizard (connect to Jellyfin/Plex/Emby, then create the admin account). Data lives in /Volume1/DockerAppData/jellyseerrdocker/ and survives restarts and updates. The container runs as uid 1000, so mounted folders must be readable by that user. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the application data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.
